summary: News Corporation filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 on September 9, 2026, furnishing its daily ASX disclosure exhibits (99.1, 99.2) for repurchases under its previously authorized stock repurchase program. The program permits up to $1 billion in aggregate purchases of Class A (NWSA) and Class B (NWS) common stock, executed from time to time. No new authorization, price, or share count is stated in this excerpt. The filing satisfies ASX daily-buyback reporting and carries forward-looking statement disclaimers. Watch actual repurchase pace and any acceleration as signals of management's valuation view.
